requirements.text: Students should be able to personalize their timetables with color-coding options for different modules and activities.
Students should have a drag-and-drop functionality for arranging their modules and study blocks.
Students should be able to hide cancelled classes and toggle their visibility.
Students should be able to add personal study blocks with annotations for specific tasks.
The system must provide an export feature for personalized timetables to sync with external calendar apps like Google Calendar or Outlook.
The system must send individual notifications for grades as soon as they are posted.
The system must send automated reminders for assignment deadlines a few days in advance.
The system must provide a weekly summary of all upcoming assignment deadlines.
Students should be able to customize their notification preferences, including options for email, SMS, or in-app notifications.
The feedback submission process must be straightforward and user-friendly.
The feedback form should include questions about the quality of content, delivery by instructors, and sufficiency of resources provided.
The feedback form must include an open-ended comments section for additional thoughts.
The feedback form must not collect any identifying information to maintain student anonymity.
Feedback should be presented to module coordinators in an aggregated, anonymized format after grades are finalized.
